## See the UI

- `./gradlew :web:wasmJsBrowserDevelopmentRun` — Browser — shared UI in a dev server
- `xcodebuild -project ios/iosApp/iosApp.xcodeproj -scheme <scheme> -destination "id=$(xcrun simctl list devices available -j | jq -r '..|objects|select(.name?=="iPhone 17")|.udid' | head -1)" build` — iOS simulator — drive by UDID, never by name
- `open docs/screenshots` — 33 captured screenshots — look before you build

## Convention plugins in use

- `shared.android.application`
- `shared.cmp.feature`
- `shared.kmp.compose`
- `shared.kmp.library`

Change one of these and every module applying it changes. That is usually the cheapest place to fix
something that appears in many modules at once.
